svg.title: Quantization trades a little precision for smaller weights
svg.desc: Absmax quantization scales values, rounds to a small integer range, and dequantizes for use. FP32 to INT8 reduces storage fourfold with rounding error. A large outlier shrinks the scale and collapses small values to few levels; LLM.int8 handles outlier dimensions in FP16.

g.text: Quantization trades a little precision for smaller weights
Scale → round to integer levels → dequantize; outliers can waste those levels.
FP32 → INT8 uses 4× fewer bits; rounding introduces bounded error.
LLM.int8(): compute outlier dimensions in FP16.
